verdict.rationale: Twenty has no dedicated assignment-rule or round-robin feature in the evidence. An ops user could still build lead routing with the generic workflow engine: trigger on record creation, use Branches for rule-based conditions, and use Record operations to set the owner. Round-robin distribution would need custom JavaScript in a Code step. Missing for 10: native lead assignment rules, built-in round-robin or load-balanced owner assignment, any documented lead-routing example, independent or hands-on corroboration.
